title: Migration/schema drift and shared database state break 42 integration tests
notes: Cluster A from the final integration run: 42 failures across ext02_webhook_dispatch_test (10), ADP/OIDC migration checks (8), env03 (5), EXP-201/202 entities (3), service catalog (6), env01/env02 (2), and 8 other cases. Observed missing webhook_subscriptions.secret_ref, missing public.tenant_realm_binding, missing tenant entity_type_instances, tenant_storage_mode_check and webhook_deliveries_status_check mismatches. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 13213-16646, 23258-38773, 38985-42352.
root_cause: TBD. Initial hypothesis: the long-lived shared integration database has migration-ledger/schema state that does not match the migration contracts expected by concurrently executed targets, with incomplete propagation into tenant schemas.
candidate_resolution: Reconcile the canonical migration ledger with actual public and tenant-schema objects, make corrective migrations idempotent, and provision each integration target from a deterministic schema baseline before validating the affected contracts.
